title: PUBLISH_OUT
description: Output contract of Publish Engine (14_PUBLISH_ENGINE.md). Terminal payload of the main pipeline; consumed by Analytics Engine. The platform enum extends the three in the spec because the page this system serves also posts to the Facebook page feed, a LINE OA, and -- for Facebook Groups, whose publishing API Meta removed in 2020 -- an offline MANUAL_KIT destination that produces a ready-to-paste folder instead of an API call.

property_id.description: Post subject key. PROP-TH-* is a pipeline property; STOCK-* a library clip with no originating listing; LAND-* a row in the land sheet recovered from an old page post; TOPIC-* a knowledge carousel, which has no property at all.

status.description: PARTIAL when at least one destination succeeded and at least one failed. DRY_RUN when nothing was actually sent.

scheduled_for.description: Set when the post was queued in Meta's Planner instead of published. published_at stays null until it actually goes out.

attempts.description: 0 means the upload was never attempted -- caption failed validation, or the destination has no credentials.

error_code.description: ERR_PUB_01 expired token, ERR_PUB_02 rate limited, ERR_PUB_03 not configured, ERR_PUB_04 upload rejected, ERR_PUB_05 caption over hard limit

kit_dir.description: MANUAL_KIT only -- folder holding video, images and caption.txt ready to paste.

cost_usd.description: Caption generation cost only. Publishing itself is free; upload bandwidth is not metered here.

x-error-codes.ERR_PUB_01: Expired OAuth token -- refresh, then retry the upload once
x-error-codes.ERR_PUB_02: Platform rate limit (HTTP 429) -- requeue this video for +30 minutes
x-error-codes.ERR_PUB_03: Destination has no credentials configured -- skipped, not an execution failure
x-error-codes.ERR_PUB_04: Platform rejected the upload (format, duration, copyright, or policy flag)
x-error-codes.ERR_PUB_05: Caption exceeded the platform hard limit and could not be trimmed safely

x-hard-rules: Never publish raw B-roll that has not been through Render Engine (no overlay, no contact card).
Never print or log access tokens, client secrets, or API keys.
Caption length limits are hard caps enforced before the API call, not after.
Every destination is dry_run unless the caller explicitly opts in to live posting.
